idea-plugin.name: JSON Canopy
idea-plugin.description:
JSON viewer & editor. Opens .json files as nested, filterable, editable tables instead of raw text, with four search modes (match anywhere, key names only, widen to the containing object, or widen to every ancestor's siblings), in-place editing with full undo support, and both light and dark themes that follow the IDE's own theme automatically.

Shown as an additional tab alongside the built-in JSON editor -- schema validation and completion stay available on their own tab, this is a specialized view, not a replacement.

Source code and issues: github.com/OldPeasant/json-canopy
